description: Use when you need recent SEC EDGAR filings for several US public companies at once: up to 10 tickers or CIKs in one POST. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /sec/filings/batch, $0.08 per call), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For one company use sec_filings.

companies.description: 1 to 10 tickers or CIKs; duplicates are removed

facts.description: optional, for every company: 0 = filings only (no XBRL facts; works for big banks too), default 1

form.description: optional, for every company: comma list of form types, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K

limit.description: optional, for every company: filings per form, as in the single call

since.description: optional, for every company: only filings filed on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

name: sec_filings_batch
title: SEC filings batch
